Definition: to exist; used in a great variety of applications (especially in connection with other words)
BiblicalUsage: Hava' is the Aramaic word for to be, to exist, and it is the word the court of Babylon uses for everything that stands. In Daniel 2:28 there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, in Daniel 2:31 the king saw a great image that stood before him, in Daniel 4:25 the king shall know that the most High ruleth, and in Ezra 5:11 the builders say they are the servants of the God of heaven and earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Aramaic is the point: the God of Israel is not only the God of Hebrew, he is the God who is, in the language of the empire itself. The king's own tongue confesses that he exists.
